# Lab 3.5: Cloud Shell & gcloud CLI Basics

## What We Are Going to Do
Use Cloud Shell to set your project, run common gcloud commands, and learn the help and format options used in every lab.

## Steps

1. **Open Cloud Shell** from the console toolbar.

2. **Check who you are and which project is set.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud auth list
gcloud config list</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Set your lab project and default region.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud config set project YOUR_PROJECT_ID
gcloud config set compute/region us-central1
gcloud config set compute/zone us-central1-a
export PROJECT_ID=$(gcloud config get-value project)
echo $PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Enable an API and list enabled APIs.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com
gcloud services list --enabled</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Shape the output.** Most labs use `--format` and `--filter`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects list --format="table(projectId,projectNumber)"
gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Use help.** Add `--help` to any command, or browse groups.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam --help
gcloud iam roles describe roles/storage.objectViewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


7. **Use the editor.** Click **Open Editor** in Cloud Shell. Files you create in your home folder stay there between sessions.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Authentication | Cloud Shell is already signed in as you |
| Home folder | 5 GB that persists between sessions |
| `--format` and `--filter` | Turn long output into exactly what you need |
| `$PROJECT_ID` | Set this variable at the start of every lab |
